title: miroSource v1
description: The immutable import snapshot kept under the root Canvas document's `miroSource` key, as the plugin reads it (see plugins/miro-canvas/src/source-model.ts) and as the converter writes it (Json_2_Canvas/Converter.py's _source_canvas_metadata). This is evidence copied from Miro's export, not a contract the plugin or converter is free to reshape, so canonical fields are typed loosely: the plugin never depends on more than 'items are present and each has an id and a type', and the converter never depends on the shape of anything under this key at all.

schema_version.description: The canonical merge schema version (scripts/merge_miro_sources.py), when this snapshot came from a REST/Web SDK merge.

source.description: The legacy wrapper _source_canvas_metadata writes when the canonical export root was neither an object nor a list.

source_surface.description: Loosely typed canonical field: how the export was captured (e.g. "canonical").

export_scope.description: Loosely typed canonical field: what the export covers (e.g. "board").

exporter_version.description: Loosely typed canonical field: the exporter's own version string.

exported_at.description: Loosely typed canonical field: when Miro's data was captured.

merged_at.description: Loosely typed canonical field: when the REST/Web SDK union was produced.

board.description: Loosely typed canonical field: board identity as Miro reports it.

source_metadata.description: Loosely typed canonical field: per-surface (rest/web_sdk) raw metadata.

provenance.description: Loosely typed canonical field: how items were merged and from where.

completeness.description: Loosely typed canonical field: what the capture is known to be missing.
